[Pending restart] In order to ensure a balanced and fair Battleground experience, the queue logic for premade Battleground groups has been updated. With this update, Battleground premade queues will be limited for premades consisting of three exceptionally high-performing players. This solves an issue where stacked premade groups like this would dominate Battlegrounds (especially during off-peak hours) and aims to promote a fair and enjoyable experience for everyone. A minimal number of players will be affected by these limitations, while a substantial portion of games will see improved balance.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Rage Winterchill] Corrected an issue where Winterchills Chains would pull player that already are being pulled by their partner or have a dead partner.

[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Archimonde] Reduced the summon radius of Ball Lightnings to 80, down from 100 yards.

[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Archimonde] Archimonde's Call Thunder Storm ability is now split into Call Thunder Storm, the initial cast, and a new spell, Eye of the Storm, functioning as the permanent effect. Eye of the Storm now inflicts damage every second to enemies within the storm's radius, up from 5.5 seconds from the previous Call Thunder Storm effect. Functionality stays the same.

[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Archimonde] Archimonde can now have a maximum of 12 Doomfire lines active at one time. This limit would be reached after 3 minutes and 30 seconds into phase 1 if no Doomfire is extinguished using Jaina's Ward of Winter.
[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Azgalor] Greatly reduced the hitbox of Legion Portals.

[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Azgalor] Thrall now summons a Cleansing Tide totem during the encounter. The Cleansing Tide Totem removes magic and curse effects from allies within 20 yards around it. The Cleansing Tide Totem is potent enough to remove Impending Doom from affected players.

[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Azgalor] Azgalor's execution effect no longer immediately kills a target. It now applies an 8-second debuff called Impending Doom to the target that will kill it and summon a guaranteed Lesser Doomguard if it runs out. Removing this effect in any other way spares the target from death and prevents the Doomguard from being summoned. Azgalor reapplies Impending Doom whenever a player falls below 5% maximum health.

[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Azgalor] Azgalor no longer executes targets below 5% health on Normal and Heroic difficulty. Azgalor no longer summons Lesser Doomguards on Normal and Heroic difficulty.
[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Kaz'rogal] Corrected an issue where Kaz'rogal would always announce both of his pillars falling.

[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Anetheron] Reduced the scale of players sent into the nightmares left behind by bodies by 50%. Player bodies now have an additional visual, drawing attention to them and specifically searching for healers in the raid by applying a visual guideline between themselves and potential healers.

[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [General] Corrected an issue where Thrall would channel his Earthquake ability on Heroic and higher difficulties. It will now remain stationary without Thrall having to channel.

[Pending Restart] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [General] Shattered Gem Fragments found inside Ancient Gem Veins are now of rare quality and can be prospected by a skilled jeweler in packs of 5. Shattered Gem Fragments can yield uncut gems of any quality.

[Pending Restart] [Zul'Aman] [General] Time Run Chests can now contain Primal Amani Idols. Primal Amani Idols can be exchanged for powerful head slot enchantments at Witch Doctor Bom'bay inside Zul'Aman for a small additional fee of gold... and sweat.

[Pending Restart] [Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] Hand of Death and Finger of Death no longer calculate damage by adding targets absorb effects to their damage output. Magtheridon now pierces all absorbption effects while executing Hand of Death and Finger of Death.

0.description: Commendations vendor will now unlock after earning the end boss achievement in any difficulty for the raid in addition to the next tier being active for the raid. This means after doing Heroic, Mythic, or Ascended you are not required to go kill normal mode to unlock the commendation vendors.

Improved the Arena matchmaking system with two changes: (1) Matchmaking rating now adjusts to actual performance much faster (up to 5-10x). (2) Team rating now converges to matchmaking rating much faster whenever there is a big gap (>300) between them. These changes have several benefits including reducing the amount of uneven games, making the initial rating climb far less grindy and making matchmaking more responsive to changes in performance.
